synergies.note: Frontline engage makes space for scalers to deal damage.
Peel keeps the hypercarry alive — the classic protect comp.
Early pressure plus poke snowballs objectives before opponents scale.

counters.note: Hard engage closes the gap before poke pays off.
Poke chips passive protect comps down without committing to a fight.
Early-game comps punish scaling comps before they come online.
